Little Red Riding Hood

Little Red sets off through the forest with a basket of honey buns for Grandma. The Wolf has a plan, but Grandma has a rolling pin. Our gentle retelling: nobody gets eaten, and the Wolf runs off over the hill.

Ages 3 to 712 spreadsHardcover

Little Red Riding Hood · page 6

Grandma peeped out of the window and saw a long grey tail. “A wolf in a hurry,” she said, and picked up her rolling pin.

The cast

Who plays who?

Any child can play any part, and you choose who's in it. Here's who usually takes each role.

Your child

Little Red

The hero, in a strawberry-red hooded cape with a basket for Grandma.

Mum, Dad or any grown-up

Mum

Packs the basket and waves Little Red off at the cottage door.

Grandma, Grandad or any grandparent

Grandma

Spots the Wolf at the window and springs the surprise.

Dad, an uncle, a big brother or sister

The woodcutter

Strides in at just the right moment.

Our own character

The Wolf

Our own comical, far-too-grinny Wolf. Silly rather than scary, and never a member of your family.

What's inside

Every copy has

  • A “Meet the characters” opening page with your whole cast
  • 12 illustrated double-page spreads
  • Your child's name in the story and on the cover
  • A dedication page with your own message
  • Hand-painted picture-book style, the same on every page
  • Hardcover, for ages 3 to 7
